prompt.en: The payday window of a sect accounting hall shut tight, a long queue of disciples in sect robes crowding outside, some knocking on the window, some raising their hands and shouting, murmurs of discontent, the accountant only a cowering silhouette behind the window, dusk light, comedic chaos, no clear faces

actionPrompt.en: Cinematic live-action shot, 35mm film look: a long queue of sect disciples in robes crowding outside a closed payday window of an accounting hall, knocking on the window, raising hands, pushing and jostling with discontent, the accountant cowering behind the window as a dark silhouette. Comedic chaos with lively natural motion. Steady camera with a slow push-in. No text, no watermark, no subtitles.

audio.text: 又到了发月例的日子——账房却支不出一块灵石。

prompt.zh: 宗门金库内景，货架空空如也，地上散落几颗灵石，一只干瘪的钱袋瘫在角落，冷白色月光从高窗照入，无人物，压抑荒诞的喜剧氛围
prompt.en: Inside the treasure vault of a cultivation sect, shelves completely empty, a few spirit stones scattered on the floor, a shriveled money pouch lying in the corner, cold pale moonlight from a high window, no people, oppressive yet absurd comedic mood

prompt.zh: 一本摊开的厚账本特写，一支朱笔圈住账页最下方的一个总数，密密麻麻的账目墨字模糊虚化不可辨认，油灯暖光，无人物，只有账本与笔
prompt.en: Close-up of a thick open account book, a red brush circling the grand total at the bottom of the page, dense rows of ledger entries blurred and illegible, warm oil-lamp light, no people, only the book and the brush

prompt.zh: 账房窗口前，弟子们举着空空的碗焦急张望，互相推挤，神情不满，无清晰人脸，闹哄哄的喜剧氛围
prompt.en: Outside the accounting-hall window, disciples holding up empty bowls and looking around anxiously, pushing each other, dissatisfied expressions, no clear faces, noisy comedic mood

prompt.zh: 宗门账房一片狼藉，账本翻烂散落一地，账房先生蹲在地上双手抓头发，背影剪影，无清晰人脸，崩溃荒诞的喜剧氛围
prompt.en: The sect accounting hall in shambles, torn account books scattered everywhere, the accountant squatting on the floor clutching his head in despair, seen from behind as a silhouette, no clear faces, breakdown comedic mood

audio.text: 金库……空了……
账上——却写着五百万？！
弟子们……一块灵石也领不到……
这钱——账本上根本看不出去了哪！！

prompt.zh: 萝卜提着裙摆从殿门外急匆匆奔入大殿，神色慌张，气喘吁吁，一手朝高台方向比划，中景，大殿灯火通明
prompt.en: Luobo the grand elder rushing in through the hall entrance, lifting her robe hem, looking flustered and breathless, gesturing urgently toward the dais with one hand, medium shot, the grand hall brightly lit by lanterns

actionPrompt.en: Cinematic live-action shot, 35mm film look: the grand elder in cyan brocade robe rushing breathlessly into a grand ancient hall through the entrance, lifting her robe hem, hair slightly disheveled, waving one arm urgently toward the dais while panting. Medium shot. Steady camera with a gentle dolly-in. Character must look identical to the reference image, same costume and face. No text, no watermark, no subtitles.

audio.text: 宗、宗主！！出——大事了！！
账房空了！！这个月的月例……一块灵石也支不出来啊！
弟子们全堵在账房外头……眼看就要闹起来了！

prompt.zh: 菜鸡坐在高台案后拍案而起，眼睛瞪得滚圆，满脸难以置信，一只手指着摊在案上的账本，中近景
prompt.en: Caiji the sect master sitting behind the desk on the platform slamming the table and rising to his feet, eyes wide open, face full of disbelief, pointing at the account book spread on the desk with one hand, medium close-up

actionPrompt.en: Cinematic live-action shot, 35mm film look: the sect master in purple robes and golden crown slamming the table and standing up in disbelief, eyes wide, jabbing a finger at the account book on his desk while shouting. Medium close-up, grand ancient hall, lantern light. Steady camera with a very gentle dolly-in. Character must look identical to the reference image, same costume and face. No text, no watermark, no subtitles.

audio.text: 不可能！我上个月刚查过账——账上明明躺着五百万灵石！

prompt.zh: 萝卜站在堂下摊开双手，一脸无奈，眼神诚恳地向上解释，眉头微蹙，中近景

actionPrompt.en: Cinematic live-action shot, 35mm film look: the grand elder in cyan brocade robe spreading her hands open with a helpless look, explaining patiently with an honest gaze, then letting out a sigh. Medium close-up, grand ancient hall. Steady camera with a very slow zoom-out. Character must look identical to the reference image, same costume and face. No text, no watermark, no subtitles.

audio.text: 账本上的数没错……可账本只记总数，不记死活。
死活？！灵石还能有死活？！
宗门这两年上马的三个『永久项目』——个个都是吃灵石的黑洞。
钱没丢——九成被吸进了洞，账本上照样写着五百万。
直到大长老把神器请了出来——
